summary: Describes a mechanism for advertising IPv6 prefixes in BGP that are tied to Color Extended Communities, to build end-to-end intent-aware paths for SRv6 services. These Colored Prefixes are the SRv6 locators, and the mechanism is called Colored Prefix Routing.

eli5.summary: Roads can get colors that mean fast, cheap or safe. This lets the network advertise addresses with colors so traffic takes the kind of road it needs.
